# BYZ scope. Test-page counter of fired X1 events.
oe_itp_count = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_itp } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_itp add = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_itp value = 1 } }
}

# BYZ scope. Take this month's main-line lock as line 15 and count the event.
oe_itp_take = {
    oe_ml_take_as = { line = 15 }
    oe_itp_count = yes
}

# Any scope. Imperial Authority $amount$ (negative = a cost), kept within 0-100.
oe_itp_auth = {
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
        change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = $amount$ }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Interface (design 4.2): the Venetian claims change by $kd$ thousand ducats (negative = paid off), never below 0.
oe_itp_add_claims = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_claims } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_claims value = 0 }
    }
    change_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_claims add = $kd$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_claims min = 0 max = 1000 }
}

# BYZ scope. The Venetian treaty runs again for 60 months; no longer lapsed.
oe_itp_pact_renewed = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_pact_m value = 60 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_lapsed } remove_variable = oe_itp_ven_lapsed }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_no_pact_ven } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_no_pact_ven }
}

# BYZ scope. Venice one tier up, within its cap. 1 -> 2: the duties on them end, the strait toll exemption is given if missing; 2 -> 3: the pledge modifier, fleet basing rights, 240 months, their opinion +30 and the rival's -10.
oe_itp_up_ven = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:VEN oe_itp_room_ven = yes }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_ven add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 2 }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_recall_ven } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_recall_ven }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    country_exists = c:VEN
                    NOT = { giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption target = c:VEN } }
                }
                create_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption first = c:BYZ second = c:VEN }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 3 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_itp_pledge_ven mode = replace }
            set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t3m_ven value = 240 }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    country_exists = c:VEN
                    NOT = { giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:fleet_basing_rights target = c:VEN } }
                }
                create_relation = { type = relation_type:fleet_basing_rights first = c:BYZ second = c:VEN }
            }
            c:VEN ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t3 target = c:BYZ } }
            c:GEN ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_rival target = c:BYZ } }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Venice one tier down. 3 -> 2: pledge, basing rights and the +30 go; 2 -> 1: we levy duties on them (the exemption stays).
oe_itp_dn_ven = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_t_ven var:oe_itp_t_ven >= 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 3 }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_pledge_ven } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_pledge_ven }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_t3m_ven } remove_variable = oe_itp_t3m_ven }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q13_ven } remove_variable = oe_itp_q13_ven }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    country_exists = c:VEN
                    giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:fleet_basing_rights target = c:VEN }
                }
                remove_relation = { type = relation_type:fleet_basing_rights first = c:BYZ second = c:VEN }
            }
            c:VEN ?= {
                if = {
                    limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t3 target = c:BYZ } }
                    remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t3 target = c:BYZ }
                }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 2 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_itp_recall_ven mode = replace }
        }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_ven add = -1 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Venice's slot back to 0: every X1 modifier, relation, tier-bound opinion and timer of the slot goes (a republic that no longer exists; the test reset).
oe_itp_clear_ven = {
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_pledge_ven } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_pledge_ven }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_recall_ven } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_recall_ven }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_no_pact_ven } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_no_pact_ven }
    if = {
        limit = {
            country_exists = c:VEN
            giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:fleet_basing_rights target = c:VEN }
        }
        remove_relation = { type = relation_type:fleet_basing_rights first = c:BYZ second = c:VEN }
    }
    c:VEN ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t3 target = c:BYZ } }
            remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t3 target = c:BYZ }
        }
    }
    c:VEN ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ } }
            remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_t3m_ven } remove_variable = oe_itp_t3m_ven }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q13_ven } remove_variable = oe_itp_q13_ven }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q9_ven } remove_variable = oe_itp_q9_ven }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep_ven } remove_variable = oe_itp_rep_ven }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep_why_ven } remove_variable = oe_itp_rep_why_ven }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep2_ven } remove_variable = oe_itp_rep2_ven }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q4_ven } remove_variable = oe_itp_q4_ven }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_lapsed } remove_variable = oe_itp_ven_lapsed }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_pact_m } remove_variable = oe_itp_ven_pact_m }
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_ven value = 0 }
}

# BYZ scope. Venice one tier up ($n$ > 0) or down ($n$ < 0).
oe_itp_shift_ven = {
    save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_itp_n value = $n$ }
    if = { limit = { scope:oe_itp_n > 0 } oe_itp_up_ven = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { scope:oe_itp_n < 0 } oe_itp_dn_ven = yes }
}

# BYZ scope. A reprisal from Venice in 3-9 months (.4); set oe_itp_rep_why_<r> after it (1 revoked, 2 lapsed).

        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_ven value = 8 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_ven value = 9 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Pisa one tier up, within its cap. 1 -> 2: the exemption modifier (Pisa's or, phase 4, Florence's), the strait toll exemption, their opinion +10.
oe_itp_up_pis = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                AND = { NOT = { var:oe_itp_slot4 ?= 2 } country_exists = c:PIS }
                AND = { var:oe_itp_slot4 ?= 2 country_exists = c:FLO }
            }
            oe_itp_room_pis = yes
        }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_pis add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_t_pis ?= 2 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_itp_slot4 ?= 2 }
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_itp_exempt_flo mode = replace }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        country_exists = c:FLO
                        NOT = {
                            giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption target = c:FLO }
                        }
                    }
                    create_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption first = c:BYZ second = c:FLO }
                }
                c:FLO ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ } }
            }
            else = {
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_itp_exempt_pis mode = replace }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        country_exists = c:PIS
                        NOT = {
                            giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption target = c:PIS }
                        }
                    }
                    create_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption first = c:BYZ second = c:PIS }
                }
                c:PIS ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ } }
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Pisa one tier down. 2 -> 1: all of that is taken back.
oe_itp_dn_pis = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_t_pis var:oe_itp_t_pis >= 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_t_pis ?= 2 }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_exempt_pis } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_exempt_pis }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_exempt_flo } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_exempt_flo }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_itp_slot4 ?= 2 }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        country_exists = c:FLO
                        giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption target = c:FLO }
                    }
                    remove_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption first = c:BYZ second = c:FLO }
                }
                c:FLO ?= {
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ } }
                        remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ }
                    }
                }
            }
            else = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        country_exists = c:PIS
                        giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption target = c:PIS }
                    }
                    remove_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption first = c:BYZ second = c:PIS }
                }
                c:PIS ?= {
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ } }
                        remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_pis add = -1 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Pisa's slot back to 0: every X1 modifier, relation, tier-bound opinion and timer of the slot goes (a republic that no longer exists; the test reset); phase 4: Pisa's and Florence's alike.
oe_itp_clear_pis = {
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_exempt_pis } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_exempt_pis }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_exempt_flo } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_exempt_flo }
    if = {
        limit = {
            country_exists = c:PIS
            giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption target = c:PIS }
        }
        remove_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption first = c:BYZ second = c:PIS }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            country_exists = c:FLO
            giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption target = c:FLO }
        }
        remove_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption first = c:BYZ second = c:FLO }
    }
    c:PIS ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t3 target = c:BYZ } }
            remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t3 target = c:BYZ }
        }
    }
    c:PIS ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ } }
            remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ }
        }
    }
    c:FLO ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t3 target = c:BYZ } }
            remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t3 target = c:BYZ }
        }
    }
    c:FLO ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ } }
            remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep_pis } remove_variable = oe_itp_rep_pis }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep_why_pis } remove_variable = oe_itp_rep_why_pis }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep2_pis } remove_variable = oe_itp_rep2_pis }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q4_pis } remove_variable = oe_itp_q4_pis }
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_pis value = 0 }
}

# BYZ scope. Ragusa one tier up, within its cap. 1 -> 2: the exemption modifier, the strait toll exemption and fondaco rights, their opinion +10.
oe_itp_up_rag = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:RAG oe_itp_room_rag = yes }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_rag add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_t_rag ?= 2 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_itp_exempt_rag mode = replace }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    country_exists = c:RAG
                    NOT = { giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption target = c:RAG } }
                }
                create_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption first = c:BYZ second = c:RAG }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    country_exists = c:RAG
                    NOT = { giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:fondaco_rights target = c:RAG } }
                }
                create_relation = { type = relation_type:fondaco_rights first = c:BYZ second = c:RAG }
            }
            c:RAG ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ } }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Ragusa one tier down. 2 -> 1: all of that is taken back.
oe_itp_dn_rag = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_t_rag var:oe_itp_t_rag >= 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_t_rag ?= 2 }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_exempt_rag } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_exempt_rag }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    country_exists = c:RAG
                    giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption target = c:RAG }
                }
                remove_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption first = c:BYZ second = c:RAG }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    country_exists = c:RAG
                    giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:fondaco_rights target = c:RAG }
                }
                remove_relation = { type = relation_type:fondaco_rights first = c:BYZ second = c:RAG }
            }
            c:RAG ?= {
                if = {
                    limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ } }
                    remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ }
                }
            }
        }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_rag add = -1 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Ragusa's slot back to 0: every X1 modifier, relation, tier-bound opinion and timer of the slot goes (a republic that no longer exists; the test reset).
oe_itp_clear_rag = {
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_exempt_rag } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_exempt_rag }
    if = {
        limit = {
            country_exists = c:RAG
            giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption target = c:RAG }
        }
        remove_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption first = c:BYZ second = c:RAG }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            country_exists = c:RAG
            giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:fondaco_rights target = c:RAG }
        }
        remove_relation = { type = relation_type:fondaco_rights first = c:BYZ second = c:RAG }
    }
    c:RAG ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t3 target = c:BYZ } }
            remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t3 target = c:BYZ }
        }
    }
    c:RAG ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ } }
            remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep_rag } remove_variable = oe_itp_rep_rag }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep_why_rag } remove_variable = oe_itp_rep_why_rag }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep2_rag } remove_variable = oe_itp_rep2_rag }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q4_rag } remove_variable = oe_itp_q4_rag }
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_rag value = 0 }
}

# BYZ scope. Ragusa one tier up ($n$ > 0) or down ($n$ < 0).
oe_itp_shift_rag = {
    save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_itp_n value = $n$ }
    if = { limit = { scope:oe_itp_n > 0 } oe_itp_up_rag = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { scope:oe_itp_n < 0 } oe_itp_dn_rag = yes }
}

# BYZ scope. A reprisal from Ragusa in 3-9 months (.4); set oe_itp_rep_why_<r> after it (1 revoked, 2 lapsed).
oe_itp_rep_set_rag = {
    random_list = {
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_rag value = 3 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_rag value = 4 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_rag value = 5 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_rag value = 6 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_rag value = 7 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_rag value = 8 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_rag value = 9 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Interface (design 4.2): oe_itp_shift = { r = ven n = -1 } - one tier up or down; modifiers, relations, opinions and caps follow. Only the sign of n counts.
oe_itp_shift = {
    oe_itp_shift_$r$ = { n = $n$ }
}

# BYZ scope. Venice straight to tier 3 (as far as its cap allows) with $months$ months left.
oe_itp_pledge_ven = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_t_ven var:oe_itp_t_ven < 2 } oe_itp_up_ven = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 1 } oe_itp_up_ven = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 2 } oe_itp_up_ven = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t3m_ven value = $months$ } }
}

# BYZ scope. Genoa straight to tier 3 (as far as its cap allows) with $months$ months left.
oe_itp_pledge_gen = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_t_gen var:oe_itp_t_gen < 2 } oe_itp_up_gen = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_gen ?= 1 } oe_itp_up_gen = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_gen ?= 2 } oe_itp_up_gen = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_gen ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t3m_gen value = $months$ } }
}

# BYZ scope. Interface (design 4.2): oe_itp_pledge = { r = ven months = 240 } (ven or gen).
oe_itp_pledge = {
    oe_itp_pledge_$r$ = { months = $months$ }
}

# BYZ scope. The start state (design 3.2): ven 2, gen 2, pis 1, rag 1 (0 for a republic that does not exist; Ragusa 1 anyway as a Venetian subject), the Venetian treaty due in 36-60 months, no claims. No modifier, relation or opinion.
oe_itp_set_start = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:VEN } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_ven value = 2 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_ven value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GEN } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_gen value = 2 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_gen value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:PIS } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_pis value = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_pis value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:RAG } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_rag value = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_rag value = 0 } }
    random_list = {
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_pact_m value = 36 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_pact_m value = 42 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_pact_m value = 48 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_pact_m value = 54 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_pact_m value = 60 } }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_claims value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_slot4 value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_cd value = 0 }
}

# BYZ scope, the first monthly call. The start state, and which foreign quarters stand in Constantinople now (their loss later lowers the cap of Venice / Genoa).
oe_itp_init = {
    set_variable = oe_itp_on
    oe_itp_set_start = yes
    if = {
        limit = { location:constantinople = { has_building = building_type:venetian_quarter } }
        set_variable = oe_itp_q_ven
    }
    if = { limit = { location:constantinople = { has_building = building_type:galata } } set_variable = oe_itp_q_gen }
}

# BYZ scope. Venice and Genoa are no longer at war (or Turin was signed): the marks go, and with them what .6 gave until the peace - the neutral port, the Genoese grain ships.
oe_itp_iw_end = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_iw } remove_variable = oe_itp_iw }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_iw_asked } remove_variable = oe_itp_iw_asked }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_iw_side } remove_variable = oe_itp_iw_side }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_iw_fake } remove_variable = oe_itp_iw_fake }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_neutral_port } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_neutral_port }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_iw_convoy }
        remove_variable = oe_itp_iw_convoy
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_grain_convoy } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_grain_convoy }
    }
}

# Location scope. One galley of the current age for the empire (age 1 and the fallback: n_traditional_galley, the type the start fleet and the Galata chain give).
oe_itp_one_galley = {
    if = {
        limit = { current_age = age_2_renaissance }
        create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = n_mediterrannean_galley owner = c:BYZ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { current_age = age_3_discovery }
        create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = n_war_galley owner = c:BYZ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { current_age = age_4_reformation }
        create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = n_galleass owner = c:BYZ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { current_age = age_5_absolutism }
        create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = n_xebec owner = c:BYZ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { current_age = age_6_revolutions }
        create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = n_xebec owner = c:BYZ }
    }
    else = { create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = n_traditional_galley owner = c:BYZ } }
}

# Any scope. $n$ galleys handed over at Constantinople, if it is ours (the pattern of gen_start_1337_setup.py and gen_s37_galata.py: a while loop in the location). Run by the worker only.
oe_itp_build = {
    location:constantinople = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } while = { count = $n$ oe_itp_one_galley = yes } } }
}

# Any scope. An X1 loan from Venice was repaid (on_loan_repaid): they think better of us. Not during a bankruptcy.
oe_itp_repaid_ven = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:VEN country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_during_bankruptcy = no } }
        c:VEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_repaid target = c:BYZ } }
    }
}

# Any scope. An X1 loan from Genoa was repaid (on_loan_repaid): they think better of us. Not during a bankruptcy.
oe_itp_repaid_gen = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GEN country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_during_bankruptcy = no } }
        c:GEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_repaid target = c:BYZ } }
    }
}

# Any scope. An X1 loan from Pisa was repaid (on_loan_repaid): they think better of us. Not during a bankruptcy. Phase 4: the slot's holder now, Pisa or Florence.
oe_itp_repaid_pis = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { var:oe_itp_slot4 ?= 2 } }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:FLO country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_during_bankruptcy = no } }
            c:FLO = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_repaid target = c:BYZ } }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:PIS country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_during_bankruptcy = no } }
            c:PIS = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_repaid target = c:BYZ } }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. An X1 loan from Ragusa was repaid (on_loan_repaid): they think better of us. Not during a bankruptcy.
oe_itp_repaid_rag = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:RAG country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_during_bankruptcy = no } }
        c:RAG = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_repaid target = c:BYZ } }
    }
}

# Any scope; scope:target = the repaid loan (on_action oe_itp_oa_repaid). The X1 loans are known by their loc key.
oe_itp_on_repaid = {
    if = { limit = { scope:target = { has_loc_key = oe_itp_loan_ven } } oe_itp_repaid_ven = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { scope:target = { has_loc_key = oe_itp_loan_gen } } oe_itp_repaid_gen = yes }
    else_if = {
        limit = { scope:target = { OR = { has_loc_key = oe_itp_loan_pis has_loc_key = oe_itp_loan_flo } } }
        oe_itp_repaid_pis = yes
    }
    else_if = { limit = { scope:target = { has_loc_key = oe_itp_loan_rag } } oe_itp_repaid_rag = yes }
}

# BYZ scope (on_action oe_itp_oa_bankrupt). Every republic we owe an X1 loan - by the monthly mark oe_itp_owes_<r>, or a loan still there - holds the default against us.
oe_itp_bankrupt = {
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_itp_owes_ven any_loan = { has_loc_key = oe_itp_loan_ven } } }
        c:VEN ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_default target = c:BYZ } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_owes_ven } remove_variable = oe_itp_owes_ven }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_itp_owes_gen any_loan = { has_loc_key = oe_itp_loan_gen } } }
        c:GEN ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_default target = c:BYZ } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_owes_gen } remove_variable = oe_itp_owes_gen }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                has_variable = oe_itp_owes_pis
                any_loan = { OR = { has_loc_key = oe_itp_loan_pis has_loc_key = oe_itp_loan_flo } }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_slot4 ?= 2 }
            c:FLO ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_default target = c:BYZ } }
        }
        else = { c:PIS ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_default target = c:BYZ } } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_owes_pis } remove_variable = oe_itp_owes_pis }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_itp_owes_rag any_loan = { has_loc_key = oe_itp_loan_rag } } }
        c:RAG ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_default target = c:BYZ } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_owes_rag } remove_variable = oe_itp_owes_rag }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. oe_itp_convoy = { months = 12 }: the chartered grain ships sail for us for $months$ months (the grain score counts them from the next monthly sync). They are no longer the wartime ships of .6 b, so the peace of the two republics does not take them away. While Bayezid's blockade runs, C7's grain stores rise by 10 through its interface oe_byd_relief (which does nothing when no blockade runs).
oe_itp_convoy = {
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_itp_grain_convoy months = $months$ mode = replace }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_iw_convoy } remove_variable = oe_itp_iw_convoy }
    oe_byd_relief = { food = 10 morale = 0 }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly, the last step of oe_itp_sync (design 3.7). The grain score is counted anew (oe_itp_grain_pts) and stored in oe_itp_grain; oe_itp_grain_was keeps last month's. The modifiers follow: 1 the road is tight, 2 it is cut, 0 neither. oe_itp_grain_m1 counts the months at 1 in a row (.8). When the score leaves 0, finance story 2 is blocked for 20 years through its own timed variable oe_fin_done_2 (design 6.7): oe_itp.7 and .8 tell the grain story from now on.
oe_itp_grain_step = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_grain } } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_grain value = 0 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_grain_was value = var:oe_itp_grain }
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_grain value = oe_itp_grain_pts }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_itp_grain >= 2 }
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_grain_tight } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_grain_tight }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_grain_cut } }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_itp_grain_cut mode = replace }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_grain_m1 } remove_variable = oe_itp_grain_m1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_itp_grain >= 1 }
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_grain_cut } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_grain_cut }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_grain_tight } }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_itp_grain_tight mode = replace }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_grain_m1 }
            change_variable = { name = oe_itp_grain_m1 add = 1 }
            clamp_variable = { name = oe_itp_grain_m1 min = 0 max = 999 }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_grain_m1 value = 1 } }
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_grain_tight } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_grain_tight }
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_grain_cut } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_grain_cut }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_grain_m1 } remove_variable = oe_itp_grain_m1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_itp_grain >= 1 var:oe_itp_grain_was < 1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fin_done_2 years = 20 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly, also while paused. In order: phase 4: Pisa gone and Florence holding pisa -> the fourth slot passes to Florence (.11 queued); a republic gone -> its slot 0; caps (expulsion: Venice / Genoa 3 -> 2 and .9 queued; Ragusa as a Venetian subject 2 -> 1); the Galata chain's result, once (abolished: Genoa 2 -> 1 without our duties, .5 queued; the peace of 1352: Venice frozen 60 months); B1's Venetian loan (+5 claims), Tenedos (claims 0), the Tenedos dispute (frozen), Turin (thawed), each once; phase 2: Venice and Genoa at war (oe_itp_iw set, and cleared at their peace or at Turin), what queues .12, the lenders we owe; timers (treaty, pledge -> .13 queued, reprisal -> .4 queued, cooldown); phase 3: the grain score.
oe_itp_sync = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { var:oe_itp_slot4 ?= 2 }
            NOT = { country_exists = c:PIS }
            country_exists = c:FLO
            location:pisa = { owner ?= c:FLO }
        }
        oe_itp_to_flo = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } has_variable = oe_itp_t_ven var:oe_itp_t_ven > 0 }
        oe_itp_clear_ven = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:GEN } has_variable = oe_itp_t_gen var:oe_itp_t_gen > 0 }
        oe_itp_clear_gen = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                OR = {
                    AND = { NOT = { var:oe_itp_slot4 ?= 2 } country_exists = c:PIS }
                    AND = { var:oe_itp_slot4 ?= 2 country_exists = c:FLO }
                }
            }
            has_variable = oe_itp_t_pis
            var:oe_itp_t_pis > 0
        }
        oe_itp_clear_pis = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:RAG } has_variable = oe_itp_t_rag var:oe_itp_t_rag > 0 }
        oe_itp_clear_rag = yes
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_over_ven = yes } set_variable = oe_itp_q9_ven oe_itp_dn_ven = yes }
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_over_gen = yes } set_variable = oe_itp_q9_gen oe_itp_dn_gen = yes }
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_over_pis = yes } oe_itp_dn_pis = yes }
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_over_rag = yes } oe_itp_dn_rag = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_s37_gal_done NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_seen_gal } }
        set_variable = oe_itp_seen_gal
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_ir_expel_done }
                country_exists = c:GEN
                NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_s37_galata }
                NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_s37_gal_curbed }
            }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_gen ?= 3 } oe_itp_dn_gen = yes }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_itp_t_gen ?= 2 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_gen value = 1 }
                set_variable = oe_itp_q5
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_s37_galata var:oe_s37_gal_r5 ?= 2 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_frozen months = 60 }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cw2_venice NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_seen_cw2v } }
        set_variable = oe_itp_seen_cw2v
        oe_itp_add_claims = { kd = 5 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = { has_country_modifier = oe_br_tenedos has_country_modifier = oe_vas_tenedos_ven }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_seen_ten }
        }
        set_variable = oe_itp_seen_ten
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_claims value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_vas_tenedos_dispute NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_seen_disp } }
        set_variable = oe_itp_seen_disp
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_frozen months = 60 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_done_17 NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_seen_turin } }
        set_variable = oe_itp_seen_turin
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_frozen } remove_variable = oe_itp_ven_frozen }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_iw }
            oe_itp_iw_end = yes
            if = { limit = { oe_itp_iw_now = yes } set_variable = oe_itp_iw set_variable = oe_itp_iw_asked }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_iw_now = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_iw } } set_variable = oe_itp_iw }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_iw oe_itp_iw_now = no } oe_itp_iw_end = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GEN is_at_war_with = c:GEN }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_gw } } set_variable = oe_itp_gw }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_gw }
        remove_variable = oe_itp_gw
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_q12 months = 36 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_why_12 value = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_cw_done NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_seen_cw } }
        set_variable = oe_itp_seen_cw
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_q12 months = 36 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_why_12 value = 2 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_cw2_done NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_seen_cw2 } }
        set_variable = oe_itp_seen_cw2
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_q12 months = 36 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_why_12 value = 3 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { any_loan = { has_loc_key = oe_itp_loan_ven } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_owes_ven } } set_variable = oe_itp_owes_ven }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_owes_ven } remove_variable = oe_itp_owes_ven }
    if = {
        limit = { any_loan = { has_loc_key = oe_itp_loan_gen } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_owes_gen } } set_variable = oe_itp_owes_gen }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_owes_gen } remove_variable = oe_itp_owes_gen }
    if = {
        limit = { any_loan = { OR = { has_loc_key = oe_itp_loan_pis has_loc_key = oe_itp_loan_flo } } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_owes_pis } } set_variable = oe_itp_owes_pis }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_owes_pis } remove_variable = oe_itp_owes_pis }
    if = {
        limit = { any_loan = { has_loc_key = oe_itp_loan_rag } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_owes_rag } } set_variable = oe_itp_owes_rag }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_owes_rag } remove_variable = oe_itp_owes_rag }
    if = {
        limit = {
            country_exists = c:VEN
            oe_itp_t_ge1_ven = yes
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_frozen }
            has_variable = oe_itp_ven_pact_m
            var:oe_itp_ven_pact_m > 0
        }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_pact_m add = -1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 3 has_variable = oe_itp_t3m_ven var:oe_itp_t3m_ven > 0 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_t3m_ven add = -1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t3m_ven <= 0 } set_variable = oe_itp_q13_ven }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_itp_t_gen ?= 3 has_variable = oe_itp_t3m_gen var:oe_itp_t3m_gen > 0 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_t3m_gen add = -1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t3m_gen <= 0 } set_variable = oe_itp_q13_gen }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep_ven }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_ven add = -1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_rep_ven <= 0 }
            remove_variable = oe_itp_rep_ven
            if = { limit = { country_exists = c:VEN } set_variable = oe_itp_q4_ven }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep_gen }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_gen add = -1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_rep_gen <= 0 }
            remove_variable = oe_itp_rep_gen
            if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GEN } set_variable = oe_itp_q4_gen }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep_pis }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_pis add = -1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_rep_pis <= 0 }
            remove_variable = oe_itp_rep_pis
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        AND = { NOT = { var:oe_itp_slot4 ?= 2 } country_exists = c:PIS }
                        AND = { var:oe_itp_slot4 ?= 2 country_exists = c:FLO }
                    }
                }
                set_variable = oe_itp_q4_pis
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep_rag }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_rag add = -1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_rep_rag <= 0 }
            remove_variable = oe_itp_rep_rag
            if = { limit = { country_exists = c:RAG } set_variable = oe_itp_q4_rag }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_cd var:oe_itp_cd > 0 } change_variable = { name = oe_itp_cd add = -1 } }
    oe_itp_grain_step = yes
}

# BYZ scope. The roll came up and .8 may fire: .8, or one of .2 / .3 / .8 at random, each as likely, among those that may fire.
oe_itp_roll8 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_itp_ok_2 = yes oe_itp_ok_3 = yes }
        random_list = { 1 = { oe_itp_fire_2 = yes } 1 = { oe_itp_fire_3 = yes } 1 = { oe_itp_fire_8 = yes } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_itp_ok_2 = yes }
        random_list = { 1 = { oe_itp_fire_2 = yes } 1 = { oe_itp_fire_8 = yes } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_itp_ok_3 = yes }
        random_list = { 1 = { oe_itp_fire_3 = yes } 1 = { oe_itp_fire_8 = yes } }
    }
    else = { oe_itp_fire_8 = yes }
}

# BYZ scope. The 10% roll came up: .2, .3 or .8 (phase 3: oe_itp_roll8), whichever may fire; one of them at random if several may.
oe_itp_roll = {
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_ok_8 = yes } oe_itp_roll8 = yes }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_itp_ok_2 = yes oe_itp_ok_3 = yes }
        random_list = { 1 = { oe_itp_fire_2 = yes } 1 = { oe_itp_fire_3 = yes } }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_itp_ok_3 = yes } oe_itp_fire_3 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_itp_ok_2 = yes } oe_itp_fire_2 = yes }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly when not paused. At most one event: first the must-fire ones (.9 .5 .13 .4, no wait for the lock), then .1, .6, .7, .12, then a 10% roll for .2 / .3 / .8, then (phase 4) a 3% roll for .10 / .11 (design 3.3).
oe_itp_events = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q9_ven } oe_itp_fire_9_ven = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q9_gen } oe_itp_fire_9_gen = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q5 } oe_itp_fire_5 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q13_ven } oe_itp_fire_13_ven = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q13_gen } oe_itp_fire_13_gen = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q4_ven } oe_itp_fire_4_ven = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q4_gen } oe_itp_fire_4_gen = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q4_pis } oe_itp_fire_4_pis = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q4_rag } oe_itp_fire_4_rag = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_itp_free = yes oe_itp_ok_1 = yes } oe_itp_fire_1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_itp_free = yes oe_itp_ok_6 = yes } oe_itp_fire_6 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_itp_free = yes oe_itp_ok_7 = yes } oe_itp_fire_7 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_itp_free = yes oe_itp_ok_12 = yes } oe_itp_fire_12 = yes }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_itp_free = yes OR = { oe_itp_ok_2 = yes oe_itp_ok_3 = yes oe_itp_ok_8 = yes } }
        random = { chance = 10 oe_itp_roll = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_itp_free = yes OR = { oe_itp_ok_10 = yes oe_itp_ok_11 = yes } }
        random = { chance = 3 oe_itp_roll4 = yes }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly: called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py LINES, id 15 "itp", condition empty); no hook of its own. No X1 event at all before 1338.1.1 (design 3.2): queued must-fire events wait until then.
oe_itp_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_on } } oe_itp_init = yes }
    oe_itp_sync = yes
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_paused = no current_date >= 1338.1.1 } oe_itp_events = yes }
}

# BYZ scope. .1 the Venetian treaty expires (optional event: cooldown). Stores the haggling chance for the event text and the AI.
oe_itp_fire_1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_hgch value = oe_itp_haggle_ch }
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_cd value = 8 }
    oe_itp_take = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itp.1
}

# BYZ scope. .2 an Italian loan: the lender is drawn among Venice and Genoa, weighted by their opinion of us. oe_itp_e2_up: the tier option a would reach (0 = none).
oe_itp_fire_2 = {
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { oe_itp_cand2_ven = yes oe_itp_cand2_gen = yes } }
        if = { limit = { oe_itp_cand2_ven = yes } c:VEN = { add_to_list = oe_itp_c2 } }
        if = { limit = { oe_itp_cand2_gen = yes } c:GEN = { add_to_list = oe_itp_c2 } }
        random_in_list = {
            list = oe_itp_c2
            weight = {
                factor = 2
                modifier = { add = 2 opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 25 } }
                modifier = { add = 2 opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 50 } }
                modifier = { factor = 0.5 opinion = { target = c:BYZ value < 0 } }
            }
            save_scope_as = oe_itp_pick
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_tgt_2 value = scope:oe_itp_pick }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e2_up value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_itp_pick = { tag = VEN } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 2 oe_itp_room_ven = yes }
                set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e2_up value = 3 }
            }
            else_if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e2_up value = 2 } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_itp_pick = { tag = GEN } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_itp_t_gen ?= 2 oe_itp_room_gen = yes }
                set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e2_up value = 3 }
            }
            else_if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_gen ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e2_up value = 2 } }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_cd value = 8 }
        oe_itp_take = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itp.2
    }
}

# BYZ scope. .4 a reprisal from Venice: one of our ships burnt if their navy is larger and we have one, else a fine of 1 month of income; then the event.
oe_itp_fire_4_ven = {
    remove_variable = oe_itp_q4_ven
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:VEN }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_tgt_4 value = c:VEN }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_why_4 value = 1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_rep_why_ven ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_why_4 value = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_rep_why_ven ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_why_4 value = 3 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_room value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { oe_itp_room_ven = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_room value = 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_slot value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_sunk value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { navy_size < oe_itp_navy_ven any_country_sub_unit = { is_ship = yes } }
            random_country_sub_unit = { limit = { is_ship = yes } destroy_subunit = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_itp_sunk value = 1 }
        }
        else = { add_gold = { value = oe_itp_m1 multiply = -1 } }
        oe_itp_take = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itp.4
    }
}

# BYZ scope. .4 a reprisal from Genoa: one of our ships burnt if their navy is larger and we have one, else a fine of 1 month of income; then the event.
oe_itp_fire_4_gen = {
    remove_variable = oe_itp_q4_gen
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GEN }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_tgt_4 value = c:GEN }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_why_4 value = 1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_rep_why_gen ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_why_4 value = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_rep_why_gen ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_why_4 value = 3 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_room value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { oe_itp_room_gen = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_room value = 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_slot value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_sunk value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { navy_size < oe_itp_navy_gen any_country_sub_unit = { is_ship = yes } }
            random_country_sub_unit = { limit = { is_ship = yes } destroy_subunit = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_itp_sunk value = 1 }
        }
        else = { add_gold = { value = oe_itp_m1 multiply = -1 } }
        oe_itp_take = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itp.4
    }
}

# BYZ scope. .4 a reprisal from Pisa (phase 4: the slot's holder now, Pisa or Florence): a fine of 1 month of income; then the event.
oe_itp_fire_4_pis = {
    remove_variable = oe_itp_q4_pis
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_itp_slot4 ?= 2 }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:FLO }
            set_variable = { name = oe_itp_tgt_4 value = c:FLO }
            set_variable = { name = oe_itp_why_4 value = 1 }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_rep_why_pis ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_why_4 value = 2 } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_room value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { oe_itp_room_pis = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_room value = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_slot value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_itp_sunk value = 0 }
            add_gold = { value = oe_itp_m1 multiply = -1 }
            oe_itp_take = yes
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itp.4
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:PIS }
            set_variable = { name = oe_itp_tgt_4 value = c:PIS }
            set_variable = { name = oe_itp_why_4 value = 1 }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_rep_why_pis ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_why_4 value = 2 } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_room value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { oe_itp_room_pis = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_room value = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_slot value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_itp_sunk value = 0 }
            add_gold = { value = oe_itp_m1 multiply = -1 }
            oe_itp_take = yes
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itp.4
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. .3 the Italians' fleet: the seller is drawn among Venice and Genoa, weighted by their opinion of us. oe_itp_e3_up = 1: option a (a pledge for the fleet) is open. No second offer for 60 months.
oe_itp_fire_3 = {
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { oe_itp_cand3_ven = yes oe_itp_cand3_gen = yes } }
        if = { limit = { oe_itp_cand3_ven = yes } c:VEN = { add_to_list = oe_itp_c3 } }
        if = { limit = { oe_itp_cand3_gen = yes } c:GEN = { add_to_list = oe_itp_c3 } }
        random_in_list = {
            list = oe_itp_c3
            weight = {
                factor = 2
                modifier = { add = 2 opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 25 } }
                modifier = { add = 2 opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 50 } }
                modifier = { factor = 0.5 opinion = { target = c:BYZ value < 0 } }
            }
            save_scope_as = oe_itp_pick
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_tgt_3 value = scope:oe_itp_pick }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e3_up value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_itp_pick = { tag = VEN } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 2 oe_itp_room_ven = yes }
                set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e3_up value = 1 }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_itp_pick = { tag = GEN } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_itp_t_gen ?= 2 oe_itp_room_gen = yes }
                set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e3_up value = 1 }
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_cd3 months = 60 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_cd value = 8 }
        oe_itp_take = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itp.3
    }
}

# BYZ scope. .7 the City short of grain: no second time for 60 months.
oe_itp_fire_7 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_cd7 months = 60 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_cd value = 8 }
    oe_itp_take = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itp.7
}

# BYZ scope. .8 the Black Sea grain treaty (the Genoese offer): no second offer for 60 months.
oe_itp_fire_8 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_cd8 months = 60 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_cd value = 8 }
    oe_itp_take = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itp.8
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_itp_lender saved. The lender gives BYZ a loan of $amt$ (a script value of BYZ) at $int$ a year ($int_ban$ after the author's ban on foreign banks) for $months$ months, under loc key $key$. The lender is funded first, as vanilla flavor_byz_ven.2 does.
oe_itp_lend = {
    save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_itp_amt value = $amt$ }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_foreign_banks_banned }
        scope:oe_itp_lender = {
            add_gold = scope:oe_itp_amt
            give_loan = {
                target = c:BYZ
                amount = scope:oe_itp_amt
                interest = $int_ban$
                months = $months$
                set_loc_key = $key$
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        scope:oe_itp_lender = {
            add_gold = scope:oe_itp_amt
            give_loan = {
                target = c:BYZ
                amount = scope:oe_itp_amt
                interest = $int$
                months = $months$
                set_loc_key = $key$
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The loan job of Venice (var oe_itp_jb_loan on it): 1 oe_itp_borrow by tier; 2 .2 b (6 months of income at 6%); 3 interest-free 10 months of income for 120 months; 4 interest-free 6 for 60.
oe_itp_loan_ven = {
    c:VEN = { save_scope_as = oe_itp_lender }
    if = {
        limit = { c:VEN = { var:oe_itp_jb_loan ?= 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 1 }
            oe_itp_lend = { amt = oe_itp_m4 int = 0.08 int_ban = 0.09 months = 60 key = oe_itp_loan_ven }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 2 }
            oe_itp_lend = { amt = oe_itp_m8 int = 0.06 int_ban = 0.07 months = 60 key = oe_itp_loan_ven }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 3 }
            oe_itp_lend = { amt = oe_itp_m12 int = 0.04 int_ban = 0.05 months = 60 key = oe_itp_loan_ven }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { c:VEN = { var:oe_itp_jb_loan ?= 2 } }
        oe_itp_lend = { amt = oe_itp_m6 int = 0.06 int_ban = 0.07 months = 60 key = oe_itp_loan_ven }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { c:VEN = { var:oe_itp_jb_loan ?= 3 } }
        oe_itp_lend = { amt = oe_itp_m10 int = 0 int_ban = 0 months = 120 key = oe_itp_loan_ven }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { c:VEN = { var:oe_itp_jb_loan ?= 4 } }
        oe_itp_lend = { amt = oe_itp_m6 int = 0 int_ban = 0 months = 60 key = oe_itp_loan_ven }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The loan job of Pisa (var oe_itp_jb_loan on it): 1 oe_itp_borrow by tier; 2 .2 b (6 months of income at 6%); 3 interest-free 10 months of income for 120 months; 4 interest-free 6 for 60. Phase 4: the slot's holder now; Florence's loans carry the loc key oe_itp_loan_flo.
oe_itp_loan_pis = {

        limit = { var:oe_itp_slot4 ?= 2 }
        c:FLO = { save_scope_as = oe_itp_lender }

# BYZ scope (the hidden worker oe_itp.99). For each slot: the loan first (it reads the tier before a shift), then down, then up. Phase 2: then the galleys bought from Venice, Genoa or Ragusa. Phase 4: the fourth slot's jobs are its holder's (Pisa or Florence); .11's tier job (oe_itp_jb_set) follows the slot jobs.
oe_itp_run_jobs = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:VEN c:VEN = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan } }
        oe_itp_loan_ven = yes
        c:VEN = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:VEN c:VEN = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn } }
        oe_itp_dn_ven = yes
        c:VEN = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:VEN c:VEN = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_up } }
        oe_itp_up_ven = yes
        c:VEN = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_up }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GEN c:GEN = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan } }
        oe_itp_loan_gen = yes
        c:GEN = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GEN c:GEN = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn } }
        oe_itp_dn_gen = yes
        c:GEN = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GEN c:GEN = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_up } }
        oe_itp_up_gen = yes
        c:GEN = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_up }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_itp_slot4 ?= 2 }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:FLO c:FLO = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan } }
            oe_itp_loan_pis = yes
            c:FLO = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:FLO c:FLO = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn } }
            oe_itp_dn_pis = yes
            c:FLO = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:FLO c:FLO = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_up } }
            oe_itp_up_pis = yes
            c:FLO = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_up }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:PIS c:PIS = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan } }
            oe_itp_loan_pis = yes
            c:PIS = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:PIS c:PIS = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn } }
            oe_itp_dn_pis = yes
            c:PIS = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:PIS c:PIS = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_up } }
            oe_itp_up_pis = yes
            c:PIS = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_up }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:RAG c:RAG = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan } }
        oe_itp_loan_rag = yes
        c:RAG = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:RAG c:RAG = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn } }
        oe_itp_dn_rag = yes
        c:RAG = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:RAG c:RAG = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_up } }
        oe_itp_up_rag = yes
        c:RAG = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_up }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_itp_slot4 ?= 2 }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:FLO c:FLO = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_set } }
            if = {
                limit = { c:FLO = { var:oe_itp_jb_set ?= 2 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_pis ?= 0 } oe_itp_up_pis = yes }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_pis ?= 1 } oe_itp_up_pis = yes }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { c:FLO = { var:oe_itp_jb_set ?= 1 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_pis ?= 2 } oe_itp_dn_pis = yes }
                else_if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_pis ?= 0 } oe_itp_up_pis = yes }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { c:FLO = { var:oe_itp_jb_set ?= 0 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_pis ?= 2 } oe_itp_dn_pis = yes }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_pis ?= 1 } oe_itp_dn_pis = yes }
            }
            c:FLO = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_set }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:PIS c:PIS = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_set } }
            if = {
                limit = { c:PIS = { var:oe_itp_jb_set ?= 2 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_pis ?= 0 } oe_itp_up_pis = yes }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_pis ?= 1 } oe_itp_up_pis = yes }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { c:PIS = { var:oe_itp_jb_set ?= 1 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_pis ?= 2 } oe_itp_dn_pis = yes }
                else_if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_pis ?= 0 } oe_itp_up_pis = yes }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { c:PIS = { var:oe_itp_jb_set ?= 0 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_pis ?= 2 } oe_itp_dn_pis = yes }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_pis ?= 1 } oe_itp_dn_pis = yes }
            }
            c:PIS = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_set }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:VEN c:VEN = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_fleet } }
        if = { limit = { c:VEN = { var:oe_itp_jb_fleet ?= 2 } } oe_itp_build = { n = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { c:VEN = { var:oe_itp_jb_fleet ?= 4 } } oe_itp_build = { n = 4 } }
        else_if = { limit = { c:VEN = { var:oe_itp_jb_fleet ?= 6 } } oe_itp_build = { n = 6 } }
        else_if = { limit = { c:VEN = { var:oe_itp_jb_fleet ?= 8 } } oe_itp_build = { n = 8 } }
        c:VEN = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_fleet }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GEN c:GEN = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_fleet } }
        if = { limit = { c:GEN = { var:oe_itp_jb_fleet ?= 2 } } oe_itp_build = { n = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { c:GEN = { var:oe_itp_jb_fleet ?= 4 } } oe_itp_build = { n = 4 } }
        else_if = { limit = { c:GEN = { var:oe_itp_jb_fleet ?= 6 } } oe_itp_build = { n = 6 } }
        else_if = { limit = { c:GEN = { var:oe_itp_jb_fleet ?= 8 } } oe_itp_build = { n = 8 } }
        c:GEN = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_fleet }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:RAG c:RAG = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_fleet } }
        if = { limit = { c:RAG = { var:oe_itp_jb_fleet ?= 2 } } oe_itp_build = { n = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { c:RAG = { var:oe_itp_jb_fleet ?= 4 } } oe_itp_build = { n = 4 } }
        else_if = { limit = { c:RAG = { var:oe_itp_jb_fleet ?= 6 } } oe_itp_build = { n = 6 } }
        else_if = { limit = { c:RAG = { var:oe_itp_jb_fleet ?= 8 } } oe_itp_build = { n = 8 } }
        c:RAG = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_fleet }
    }
}

# Any scope. One debug-log line with X1's state (tiers, claims, treaty months, frozen, loans owed; phase 3: f the grain score).
oe_itp_log = {
    debug_log = "OE_ITP p1 v=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_itp_t_ven').GetValue|0] g=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_itp_t_gen').GetValue|0] p=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_itp_t_pis').GetValue|0] r=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_itp_t_rag').GetValue|0] c=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_itp_ven_claims').GetValue|0] pact=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_itp_ven_pact_m').GetValue|0] fz=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_itp_frozen_v')|0] lp=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_itp_lapsed_v')|0] l=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_itp_loan_left')|0] f=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_itp_grain_v')|0]"
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. Back to the start (ven 2, gen 2, pis 1, rag 1): every X1 modifier, X1 relation, tier-bound opinion, timer, mark and job goes; the quarters seen at init stay. The Galata / B1 / B2 results are read again next month. Phase 2: the war marks and what .6 gave, the .12 queue, the own-fleet modifier; ships already handed over stay. Phase 3: the grain score back to 0 with its modifiers, the chartered ships, the waits of .7 and .8, the price cap, the test page's fake strain (the next monthly sync counts anew). Phase 4: the fourth slot back to Pisa (if Pisa is gone and Florence holds pisa, the next sync passes it again and queues .11), the .11 queue and the wait of .10.
oe_itp_test_reset = {
    oe_itp_clear_ven = yes
    oe_itp_clear_gen = yes
    oe_itp_clear_pis = yes
    oe_itp_clear_rag = yes
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_pact_m } remove_variable = oe_itp_ven_pact_m }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_lapsed } remove_variable = oe_itp_ven_lapsed }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_frozen } remove_variable = oe_itp_ven_frozen }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_claims } remove_variable = oe_itp_ven_claims }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_cd } remove_variable = oe_itp_cd }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_seen_gal } remove_variable = oe_itp_seen_gal }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_seen_cw2v } remove_variable = oe_itp_seen_cw2v }

    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_tgt_2 } remove_variable = oe_itp_tgt_2 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_tgt_4 } remove_variable = oe_itp_tgt_4 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_tgt_9 } remove_variable = oe_itp_tgt_9 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_tgt_13 } remove_variable = oe_itp_tgt_13 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_why_4 } remove_variable = oe_itp_why_4 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_sunk } remove_variable = oe_itp_sunk }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_e2_up } remove_variable = oe_itp_e2_up }

    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_e4_slot } remove_variable = oe_itp_e4_slot }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_hg } remove_variable = oe_itp_hg }

        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_fleet } remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_fleet }

    c:PIS ?= {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_bcd } remove_variable = oe_itp_bcd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_pcd } remove_variable = oe_itp_pcd }

        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_pcd } remove_variable = oe_itp_pcd }

        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_up } remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_up }

        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_set } remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_set }

    oe_itp_iw_end = yes
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_gw } remove_variable = oe_itp_gw }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q12 } remove_variable = oe_itp_q12 }

    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_own_fleet } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_own_fleet }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_grain_fake } remove_variable = oe_itp_grain_fake }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_grain_cap } remove_variable = oe_itp_grain_cap }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_cd7 } remove_variable = oe_itp_cd7 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_cd8 } remove_variable = oe_itp_cd8 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_own_grain } remove_variable = oe_itp_own_grain }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_grain_m1 } remove_variable = oe_itp_grain_m1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_grain_was } remove_variable = oe_itp_grain_was }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_grain_convoy } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_grain_convoy }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_grain_tight } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_grain_tight }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_grain_cut } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_grain_cut }
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_grain value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q11 } remove_variable = oe_itp_q11 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_cd10 } remove_variable = oe_itp_cd10 }
    set_variable = oe_itp_on
    oe_itp_set_start = yes
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. .3 now, whatever the war and the cooldown: Venice if it holds tier 2 or 3, else Genoa (nothing if neither does).
oe_itp_test_fire_3 = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:VEN oe_itp_tier_ge_ven = { n = 2 } }
        c:VEN = { add_to_list = oe_itp_c3 }
        random_in_list = {
            list = oe_itp_c3
            weight = {
                factor = 2
                modifier = { add = 2 opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 25 } }
                modifier = { add = 2 opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 50 } }
                modifier = { factor = 0.5 opinion = { target = c:BYZ value < 0 } }
            }
            save_scope_as = oe_itp_pick
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_tgt_3 value = scope:oe_itp_pick }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e3_up value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_itp_pick = { tag = VEN } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 2 oe_itp_room_ven = yes }
                set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e3_up value = 1 }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_itp_pick = { tag = GEN } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_itp_t_gen ?= 2 oe_itp_room_gen = yes }
                set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e3_up value = 1 }
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_cd3 months = 60 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_cd value = 8 }
        oe_itp_take = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itp.3
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GEN oe_itp_tier_ge_gen = { n = 2 } }
        c:GEN = { add_to_list = oe_itp_c3 }
        random_in_list = {
            list = oe_itp_c3
            weight = {
                factor = 2
                modifier = { add = 2 opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 25 } }
                modifier = { add = 2 opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 50 } }
                modifier = { factor = 0.5 opinion = { target = c:BYZ value < 0 } }
            }
            save_scope_as = oe_itp_pick
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_tgt_3 value = scope:oe_itp_pick }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e3_up value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_itp_pick = { tag = VEN } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 2 oe_itp_room_ven = yes }
                set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e3_up value = 1 }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_itp_pick = { tag = GEN } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_itp_t_gen ?= 2 oe_itp_room_gen = yes }
                set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e3_up value = 1 }
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_cd3 months = 60 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_cd value = 8 }
        oe_itp_take = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itp.3
    }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY (button itp2merc, decision 206). BYZ scope. The design's hired fleet in its smallest form: a mercenary company of 4 galleys based at Constantinople for 24 months, hired by us. oe_itp_merc_made: 1 the company exists and was hired, 2 create_mercenary gave no company. The notes say what to look at in game.
oe_itp_test_merc = {
    create_mercenary = {
        name = oe_itp_merc_fleet
        home = location:constantinople
        categories = { navy_galley = 4 }
        months = 24
        cost_multiplier = 1
        save_scope_as = oe_itp_mfleet
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_itp_mfleet }
        hire_mercenary = scope:oe_itp_mfleet
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_merc_made value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_merc_made value = 2 } }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. One more point of strain on the grain road (oe_itp_grain_fake, at most 2), then the grain step at once, so the score and the modifiers show without waiting for the month.
oe_itp_test_grain_up = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_grain_fake }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_grain_fake add = 1 }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_itp_grain_fake min = 0 max = 2 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_grain_fake value = 1 } }
    oe_itp_grain_step = yes
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. The fake strain and the price cap go; the grain step runs at once.
oe_itp_test_grain_clear = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_grain_fake } remove_variable = oe_itp_grain_fake }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_grain_cap } remove_variable = oe_itp_grain_cap }
    oe_itp_grain_step = yes
}

# BYZ scope, from the sync: Pisa is gone and Florence holds location:pisa. The fourth slot passes to Florence with its tier (design 3.3: the tier is kept); a tier 2 is rebuilt for Florence (Pisa's exemption goes, Florence's comes with the toll exemption and +10). Pisa's pending reprisal goes with Pisa. .11 is queued.
oe_itp_to_flo = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_slot4 value = 2 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep_pis } remove_variable = oe_itp_rep_pis }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep_why_pis } remove_variable = oe_itp_rep_why_pis }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep2_pis } remove_variable = oe_itp_rep2_pis }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q4_pis } remove_variable = oe_itp_q4_pis }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_itp_t_pis ?= 2 }
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_exempt_pis } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_exempt_pis }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_pis value = 1 }
        oe_itp_up_pis = yes
    }
    set_variable = oe_itp_q11
}

# BYZ scope. The 3% roll came up: .10 or .11, whichever may fire; one of them at random if both may.
oe_itp_roll4 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_itp_ok_10 = yes oe_itp_ok_11 = yes }
        random_list = { 1 = { oe_itp_fire_10 = yes } 1 = { oe_itp_fire_11 = yes } }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_itp_ok_11 = yes } oe_itp_fire_11 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_itp_ok_10 = yes } oe_itp_fire_10 = yes }
}
